# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest published release of the
`Inandu.Grid.Extensions` packages on nuget.org.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 0.3.x   | ✅        |
| < 0.3   | ❌        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue for security problems.**

Report privately via GitHub's ["Report a vulnerability"](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid-extensions/security/advisories/new)
form on the repository's Security tab. If that is unavailable to you, contact
Inandu SAS via <https://www.inandu.com/contact/> instead.

Please include:

- affected package(s) and version(s),
- a description of the issue and its impact,
- a minimal proof of concept if you have one.

We aim to acknowledge reports within a few business days, agree on a disclosure
timeline with you, and credit you in the release notes unless you prefer to
remain anonymous.
